confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several Berlin-specific aggregated sources (Expatistan, Mylifeelsewhere, Getwherenext, Movinga, Expat Exchange) that broadly agree, but they are modelled rather than surveyed and some are undated. The midrange meal is the widest spread (about EUR 30 to 64 across sources, which mix drinks and courses), so it is set toward the upper-middle for three courses without drinks. Cocktail rests on Expatistan (9 data points) plus an undated range. No reliable 2026 wine-by-the-glass price was found, so wine_glass is derived from a Movinga neighbourhood-bar wine price of about EUR 5 and a restaurant markup relative to the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July 2026 window; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings were checked. USD figures use an internal EUR-to-USD working assumption of about 1.14, taken from a conversion shown in one source, not from an FX source. FX: 0.6955 is the RBA observation for 15 Oct 2026 reported on the RBA exchange-rates page. The first FX search returned only stale March 2026 data, so one further search was run. A secondary site's 16 Oct figure (0.6947) could not be confirmed and was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution was needed for restaurant and drink anchors, which are based on Berlin-specific aggregated sources. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate drawn from general knowledge of Berlin's hostel and hotel market in summer, not from any searched listing or price page.
